text: あくりょうが　のりうつって　あばれてるのじゃ！

structure.jp: あくりょうが　のりうつって

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. のりうつって = 'they possess (people) and...'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; てる is the shortened spoken form. あばれてる = 'are running wild'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives an explanation, like 'the thing is'; じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. あばれてるのじゃ = 'it's that they are running wild!'.
